history_summary: Add reference GTDB correspondences to the existing Set2 Lactobacillus descriptors
history_details: Preserve the LBB04/C001.27/C5I3 Set2 composition, NCBI species and lactis subspecies identities, existing S. thermophilus block and all biological claims. Native reference populations are 378 genomes/fraction 1.0 and 37 genomes/fraction 1.0; these do not establish exact study-stock assembly membership. Only the two selected taxonomy blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. Original history and source limits remain unchanged. Scoped database and provenance correction; full scientific approval and corpus QC are separate.
